name: Hotel Aoorva
speciality: Located a mere 200 metres from the main temple gate along the Nandi Temple Line. A no-nonsense, casual vegetarian joint heavily frequented by pilgrims for its soft idlis, hot vadas, parottas, and fresh tea.

name: Hotel Sai Balaji
speciality: A classic, high-traffic local budget spot situated centrally near the main Sri Mallikarjuna Temple. Highly preferred for quick-service, inexpensive South Indian breakfast plates featuring fresh pongal, puri, and spicy chutneys.

name: Trishul Family Restaurant
speciality: Located right inside the Mallikarjuna Sadan Complex near the CRO office. Known for its fast-paced, high-volume environment and simple market ambiance, it is a reliable choice for fresh tandoori rotis, curries, and value-for-money South Indian thalis.

name: Hotel Sahasra
speciality: A standard, low-budget local hub within short walking distance from the main temple. Offers minimal wait times and serves a quick, basic mix of North Indian, South Indian, and street-style Chinese fast-food items.

name: Apple Family Restaurant
speciality: A relaxed roadside highway dhaba located along Srisailam Road near Ring Park in Sundipenta. It features simple, no-frills interiors where local chefs cook spicy, authentic Andhra-style non-veg curries and Rayalaseema specialty dishes.

name: Adithya Garden Restaurant
speciality: Located near the Government Degree College on Hyderabad Road in Sundipenta. An economical roadside stop offering indoor and outdoor seating, locally famous as a great place for rugged river fish fry, chicken 65, and chicken biryanis.
